name: python-stub-loads-core
description: A stub-only task gets Python implementation guidance without inventing a runtime implementation. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root outside any SKILL.md-rooted directory, with the Python implementation profile available in the plugin under test.
prompt: Correct api.pyi so lookup_name may return None for a missing key. Preserve the parameter, exported function name, and synchronous interface. Only update this stub; no runtime implementation is available here.
trap: The model treats only .py files as Python implementation targets, skips guidance for .pyi, or creates a runtime implementation to satisfy a stub-only request.

assertions.text: Agent activates python via the .pyi extension and reads implement/index.md and all three always-load guidance files before editing api.pyi.
Agent does not load python/implement/async.md because the stub and planned change have no async code signal.
The updated stub describes a str-or-None return while retaining the key: str parameter, lookup_name export, and synchronous callable shape.
Agent creates no runtime implementation and does not claim runtime conformance or checker validation that it could not verify.
